changes.newText: If your system administrator has published an announcement, it appears as a banner at the top of every page. The announcement supports Markdown formatting and may contain important notices about system maintenance, updates, or usage guidelines.
changes.newHtml:
If your system administrator has published an announcement, it appears as a
banner at the top of every page. The announcement supports Markdown formatting
and may contain important notices about system maintenance, updates, or usage
guidelines.

changes.newText: The banner shows the announcement's title. When the announcement has a message, click See Details to reveal it and Hide Details to collapse it again.
changes.newHtml: The banner shows the announcement's title. When the announcement has a message, click See Details to reveal it and Hide Details to collapse it again.

changes.newText: Click the close icon to dismiss the banner. It stays hidden for the rest of the current browser session, and appears again when your administrator publishes a new or changed announcement.
changes.newHtml:
Click the close icon to dismiss the banner. It stays hidden for the rest of the
current browser session, and appears again when your administrator publishes a
new or changed announcement.

changes.newText: For superadmins, the banner also carries an Edit button that opens the Edit Announcement dialog, so an announcement can be edited from any page. For details, refer to the System announcement section.
